items.title: 用户可看到 real-data corpus/gold/query/result baseline
items.context: 跑 real-data baseline 命令后，用户能看到并审计非空 corpus/gold/query/result、真实 sourcePath/sourceHash/recordId、scoreable lifecycle layers 与 boundary-only/advisory layers 的分离，以及 dataset stats。该产物用于证明真实项目数据可以进入 baseline 验证，而不是只完成内部契约定义。
items.userSees: Terminal includes: "Real Memory Benchmark Data: PASS", "corpusRecords=... goldRecords=... queries=...", "scoreableLayers=raw_event_memory,lifecycle_state_memory,checklist_evidence_memory,summary_memory", "boundaryOnlyRecords=... excludedFromScoring=true" and "note: Benchmark PASS is not Koala lifecycle gate authority".

happy.desc: 运行 real-data baseline 命令后，终端或 JSON 输出展示 non-empty corpus/gold/query/result 统计，并包含真实 sourcePath、sourceHash、recordId，使用户能审计 baseline 来自真实项目数据而非占位样本。

edge.desc: 当结果同时包含 scoreable lifecycle layers 与 boundary-only/advisory layers 时，输出必须把两者分开展示并给出各自计数，证明 boundary-only 数据没有被伪装成可评分真相源。

adversarial.desc: 即使 real-data baseline 产物看起来完整，输出也必须保留 non-authoritative 基线说明，不得把 benchmark 结果表述成 gate evidence 或最终真相源结论。

verificationEvidence.note: Real repository lifecycle data returned Real Memory Benchmark Data: PASS with corpusRecords=389, goldRecords=389, queryRecords=389, resultRecords=389, exactRecordMatchRate=1.000, and printed sourcePath/sourceHash/record counts for 36 sources.

Result artifact reports scoreable layers raw_event_memory,lifecycle_state_memory,checklist_evidence_memory,summary_memory; boundary-only layers advisory_memory,host_transcript_memory; boundaryGoldRecords=0 and boundaryQueryRecords=0.
JSON output and docs preserve the non-authoritative note: not lifecycle gate authority, review pass, validation evidence, delivery check, receipt, vector DB, or production memory architecture.

items.title: 新增 real-data benchmark CLI 产出 artifact
items.context: 在现有 memory benchmark 基础上新增命令，默认可 text/json 输出真实数据 baseline；可选 outputDir 写出 corpus.jsonl、gold.jsonl、queries.jsonl、result.json。命令不得写 gate evidence，不得把 advisory/dev-memory 升级为 truth。
items.userSees: memory_benchmark_real_data --outputDir=<dir> writes corpus.jsonl, gold.jsonl, queries.jsonl, result.json and prints their paths plus PASS/FAIL status.

happy.desc: 执行 real-data benchmark CLI 并传入 outputDir 后，用户能在指定目录看到 corpus.jsonl、gold.jsonl、queries.jsonl、result.json 四个文件，且终端明确打印这些路径与 PASS/FAIL 汇总。

edge.desc: 写出的 result.json 和终端摘要必须明确标注哪些内容处于 non-authority boundary，尤其是 boundary-only 或 advisory 数据不能被写成 scoreable gold/result 主体。

adversarial.desc: 当输入跨越真实 authority 数据与 dev-memory 边界时，artifact 只能导出 real-data baseline 所需的真实数据与 boundary 注释；dev-memory 内容若仅属 boundary-only，应被排除在 scoreable corpus/gold/query/result 之外。

verificationEvidence.note: OutputDir run printed PASS plus four paths; inspected corpus.jsonl/gold.jsonl/queries.jsonl/result.json existed, with 374 lines in each JSONL file.

verificationEvidence.command: node -e inspect .tmp/memory-real-baseline first rows and result.json
verificationEvidence.note: Inspected first corpus/gold/query rows: each carried recordId, layer, sourcePath, sourceHash; result.json reported PASS with corpus/gold/query counts of 374.
Smoke asserted dev-memory advisory records remain boundary-only and excluded from scoreable gold/query; command policy is readOnly, non-gate evidence, destructiveRisk=none, process fact level L0.

items.title: 用真实数据验证 baseline scoring 与边界
items.context: 增加 smoke 覆盖：真实 activity/story 数据非空、gold query 可匹配、recall/answer/evidence linkage 分数可计算；boundary-only 数据不进入 recall/precision；缺少真实数据时给出明确失败而不是虚假 PASS。
items.userSees: Smoke/CLI transcript includes: "realDataScore=...", "goldHitRate=1.000", "evidenceLinkageRate=1.000", "devMemoryExcludedFromScoring=true", and empty activity/story input returns "Real Memory Benchmark Data: FAIL" with a missing-real-data reason.

happy.desc: 基于真实 activity/story 数据运行 smoke 或 CLI transcript 时，用户能看到非空 real data 被用于 scoring，gold query 可以匹配到真实记录，且 recall/answer/evidence linkage 分数被实际计算出来。

edge.desc: 若数据集中同时存在可评分真实数据和仅用于边界说明的 dev-memory 内容，输出必须证明 dev-memory 仅停留在 boundary-only exclusion，不进入 recall/precision 或 gold 命中计算。

adversarial.desc: 当 real activity/story 数据为空、不可解析或只剩 boundary-only 内容时，命令必须显式 FAIL 并解释缺少真实数据，而不是生成看似成功的空 baseline 或 fake PASS。

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke seeded real activity/story/checklist/summary/evidence data, then asserted PASS, exactRecordMatchRate=1, non-empty gold/query/results, and trace fields on corpus/gold/query/result rows.
Smoke seeded a dev-memory record and asserted devMemoryBoundaryRecords=1 while gold/queries contain no dev-memory sourcePath rows.

Smoke seeded a root with only boundary dev-memory and no real activity/story data; command returned FAIL with missing real activity source and missing real story source root reasons, and no gold/query records.
